scene.label: Act 3, Scene 3
scene.title: SCENE III. Another part of the island.

content.text: Enter Alonso, Sebastian, Antonio, Gonzalo, Adrian, Francisco, &c.

content.text: Solemn and strange music: and Prospero above, invisible. Enter several strange Shapes, bringing in a banquet: they dance about it with gentle actions of salutation; and inviting the King &c., to eat, they depart.

lines.text: What harmony is this? My good friends, hark!
lines.plainText: What harmony is this My good friends hark

lines.text: Marvellous sweet music!
lines.plainText: Marvellous sweet music

lines.text: Give us kind keepers, heavens! What were these?
lines.plainText: Give us kind keepers heavens What were these

lines.text: A living drollery. Now I will believe

lines.text: That there are unicorns; that in Arabia
lines.plainText: That there are unicorns that in Arabia

content.text: Thunder and lightning. Enter Ariel like a Harpy; claps his wings upon the table; and, with a quaint device, the banquet vanishes.

lines.text: You are three men of sin, whom Destiny,
lines.plainText: You are three men of sin whom Destiny

lines.text: That hath to instrument this lower world
lines.plainText: That hath to instrument this lower world

lines.text: And what is in't,—the never-surfeited sea
lines.plainText: And what is in'tthe neversurfeited sea

lines.text: Hath caused to belch up you; and on this island
lines.plainText: Hath caused to belch up you and on this island

lines.text: Where man doth not inhabit; you 'mongst men
lines.plainText: Where man doth not inhabit you 'mongst men

lines.text: Being most unfit to live. I have made you mad;
lines.plainText: Being most unfit to live I have made you mad

lines.text: Their proper selves.
lines.plainText: Their proper selves

content.text: [He vanishes in thunder: then, to soft music, enter the Shapes again, and dance, with mocks and mows, and carry out the table.]
